PRIVACY, IN PLAIN WORDS

Searches require Tor. Providers receive your query through a Tor exit connection. Click a result to read it here through Tor, without a separate browser.

What stays private?

Hoyahh stores no search history, cookies, or browser storage. Search queries and destination DNS use the Tor proxy. SearXNG has no direct internet route in the supplied Docker configuration. Failed Tor checks block searches.

Hoyahh’s reading view fetches HTTPS pages through Tor and shows text and links. It does not load the website’s scripts, images, cookies, or forms. Links inside the reading view stay in Hoyahh. Copying an address and opening it outside Hoyahh uses that browser’s connection.

Tor does not make you untraceable. Personal logins, identifying searches, malware, or traffic analysis can reveal identity. Your ISP may see Tor use. Tor guard state is kept locally to avoid choosing fresh guards on every restart; it is not search history.
